about_the_game:
Frogdoku

Hop, think, and leap your way across peaceful waters.

Description

Frogdoku is a 3D grid-based puzzle game where logic, planning, and spatial awareness are key. As Konna, a clever frog, your mission is to arrange lily pads into a viable path, then leap across them to safety.

Merge logic with rhythm as you arrange lily pads into harmonious patterns that unlock your path. With stylized visuals, ambient sound, and fluid movement.

Puzzles start simple, but quickly evolve into intricate brain teasers where every move can lead to victory, or a splash! Inspired by the elegance of Sudoku and the movement logic of block puzzles, Frogdoku offers a rewarding challenge for puzzle enthusiasts.

Features

  • 🐸 Rearrange lily pads to solve grid-based puzzles

  • 🌼 A gentle difficulty curve that grows into serious challenge

  • 🌿 3D stylized environments that mimic the coziness of 2D illustration.

  • 🎵 Relaxing music and soundscapes from peaceful wetlands

  • 🌿 Minimalist UI and serene visuals for a calm experience

short_description: Leap into a shimmering pond as Konna, a bright little frog with a knack for patterns. Arrange glowing lily pads into flowing paths, discovering puzzles that ripple with rhythm and calm. With every hop comes a mix of clever challenge, soothing sounds, and playful splashes.
